what: Media for the Medium and Substack versions of RL From Zero Part 2 (DQN), captured at device scale factor 2 from the post’s own figures.

first-update.gif.source: Figure 1, update 1 of the recorded run: the gradient step first, then collect, look ahead, target, error and step
first-update.gif.interpretation: One recorded update, not an animation of training. The first frame is the gradient step, so a still copy makes sense alone.

first-update.png.source: the gradient step (the GIF’s first frame) at its natural height and 2x

target-sync.png.source: Figure 2, minibatch averages over the first 1,500 recorded updates

exploration.png.source: Figure 3, holds of 20 to 60 steps, seed 7, computed in the browser with the MountainCar equations
exploration.png.interpretation: Random exploration only, not the training run; counts depend on the seed.
